title: Two-Source Rates for Long-Term Treatment Effects with Estimated Bridge Loadings
banked_reason: D0.5 typed kernel_substituted: the promised causal minimax converse and honest-length lower bound remain conditional on an unresolved positive common-latent likelihood lift; the residual-efficiency claim is absent, and the upper proof has an unrepaired random-denominator bias.
gap_reasons: The promised causal minimax frontier is not delivered: the matching converse remains conditional on the unresolved common-latent complete-likelihood lift, so the current theorem establishes an upper envelope rather than the advertised structural minimax result.

No node determines when overidentifying residuals strictly improve an efficiency constant, although that is a headline promise; this proposition supplies only a range/regularity boundary and expressly disclaims the efficiency comparison.
proof_attempt_summary: D-0.5 accepted a narrowed externally calibrated convolution model; D0 developed a spectral estimator, upper envelope, and a conditional two-source frontier. D0.5 found that the positive common-latent complete-likelihood lift, matched honest-length lower bound, and residual-efficiency comparison were not delivered. An independent validity check also found an unrepaired random-denominator bias in the unconditional upper proof, so no sound downgraded theorem is certified by this run.
tldr: Imbens, Kallus, Mao, and Wang supply the bridge-identification formula used as notation. In the externally calibrated finite-stratum convolution subclass, a literal observable estimator and bias-aware connected interval have unconditional upper orders governed by \(R_{n_E,n_O}\). Under a stable source ratio, the classical three regimes persist when \(p\ge 1/2\); when \(0<p<1/2\), estimated-loading noise strictly determines the frontier for \(a+p<b<a+1-p\) and absorbs the fixed-loading logarithmic elbow at \(b=a+1/2\). Matching minimax and honest-length claims remain conditional on the unresolved positive common-latent complete-likelihood lift. Conditional subclass converse bounds transfer upward by inclusion, but the calibrated upper bounds and minimax equality do not.
gap: ImbensKallusMaoWang2024 identifies ALTTE under six latent restrictions, ChenXie2026 supplies observational equivalence, local just-identification, and the ALTTE efficient influence function, and BreunigJohannes2016 Proposition 3.6 gives the fixed-loading inverse-functional trichotomy under its ordinary-smooth link and smoothness conditions. None determines the two-source compact minimax or honest-length frontier when the experimental loading is estimated independently.
fill: A literal estimator adds a calibrated finite stratum-constant block to thresholded nonconstant Fourier coordinates and establishes the unconditional upper frontier. Finite-block positive common-latent Le Cam pairs and correlated-sign mixtures that preserve the fixed strata, Haar marginals, and additive symmetric convolution form target the matching conditional minimax and connected-interval converses.
